name: Relativistic Two-Body Problem and Gravitational Waves
methods: Model orbital decay from quadrupole gravitational radiation
Compute chirp mass M from observed frequency and frequency derivative (f and dot{f})
Evaluate strain amplitude h at astronomical detector distance
Track post-Newtonian inspiral leading to merger and ringdown phases
problem_types: Hulse-Taylor binary pulsar orbital decay verification
LIGO/Virgo gravitational wave detection from binary black hole coalescences
Estimation of total energy radiated in gravitational waves during merger
pitfalls: Forgetting dipole radiation is forbidden in General Relativity (quadrupole is lowest order)
Confusing orbital frequency with gravitational wave frequency (f_GW = 2 * f_orbital)
